title: 第9章 请未婚妻赏脸第10章 退婚
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀
content_zh:
听见刚刚自己瞎编的话，被真言符测试过。
昭杺柠此刻内心慌乱，但脸色却十分淡定，还当着钟离珟的面自信点头：“我说的都是实话，肯定会通过真言符的测试啊。”
“你还算老实，没有扯谎骗我。”钟离珟哼声。
“我怎么可能骗你嘛，我真来自青青草原。”昭杺柠连忙点头。
见昭杺柠一脸乖巧，钟离珟看上去也像是将对她的怀疑全部打消，连带着面向昭杺柠的笑容都和善不少：“看你还算诚实，跟我走吧。”
“去哪？”昭杺柠见这个有疑心病的剑修总算信自己了，内心也松了一口气。
“回洞府，在问剑峰你跟我住一起。”钟离珟回答。
“原来是回家呀。”昭杺柠听此，一脸喜悦还走在钟离珟前面。
她背着双手，倒着走两步，笑看钟离珟，可怜开口：“未婚夫，你知道的，我如今回不了家，只有你一个亲人了。”
“嗯。”钟离珟点头应声。
见他回应配合自己，昭杺柠更是心情大好，按照钟离珟指的方向，快步走在前面。
落她两步的钟离珟，目光幽幽盯着贴在昭杺柠身后的符箓一张接着一张燃尽。
每一张，所燃的火焰都是蓝色。
钟离珟桃花眸危险眯起，内心冷哼。
小骗子，嘴里没一句是实话。
走在前面的昭杺柠，根本不知道自己背后已经燃了几十张真言符。
她只感到，这问剑峰是真难爬啊。
爬了半天，才到半山腰，入眼全是林木，以及看不见尽头的石梯。
上山之路爬得昭杺柠腿软。
此刻她弯腰双手撑在膝盖上，偏头疑惑看向落后她几步，闲庭信步走来的钟离珟质疑：“你的住所到底在哪？爬山这么久除了我俩是人，一个人影都没看见。”

“谁说走这么久我俩是人。”钟离珟反问。
他两步上前，单蹲在昭杺柠面前，笑容诡异，话音幽幽：“深山老林多有精怪出没，或许你我之间，只有一个是真人。”
“你说，这唯一的真人，是你……还是我？”钟离珟伸手，指尖冰冷从昭杺柠颈侧滑过。
昭杺柠因为爬山剧烈跳动的心脏，此刻被他这么一吓，跳得更猛了。
她扬手就是一巴掌，猛得朝钟离珟右脸扇去，大声呵斥：“大胆邪祟，快从我未婚夫身上下去。”
“啊啊啊，邪祟快退！退退退！”一巴掌不够，昭杺柠双手按住钟离珟肩膀拼命摇晃。
左右脸各顶着一深一浅两个巴掌印的钟离珟摇了摇脑袋，连忙抓住昭杺柠手腕，并站起身来：“别晃了，没有邪祟。”
“未婚夫，你是不知道，刚刚有邪祟上你身还吓唬我。”昭杺柠可怜泣声。
钟离珟临到嘴巴那句，是他见昭杺柠胆小，本打算吓唬吓唬昭杺柠的解释半天没敢说出口。
实在是没脸敢说。
昭杺柠胆小归胆小，但有事她是真敢上啊。
钟离珟两次实践发现，有巴掌昭杺柠也是真敢扇。
content_en:
Hearing what he just made up, he was tested by the mantra.
Zhao Hao Ning was panicking at the moment, but her face was very calm. She nodded confidently in front of Zhong Lizui: "What I told is the truth. I will definitely pass the test of the mantra."
"You are quite honest and didn't lie to me." Zhong Lizui snorted.
"How could I lie to you? I really come from Qingqing Grassland." Zhao Hao Ning nodded quickly.
Seeing Zhao Hao Ning's well-behaved face, Zhong Lizui seemed to have dispelled all doubts about her. He even smiled kindly towards Zhao Hao Ning: "I see you are quite honest, come with me."
"Where are you going?" Zhao Hao Ning felt relieved when she saw that this suspicious swordsman finally believed in her.
"Back to the cave, I asked Jianfeng if you would live with me." Zhong Lizui replied.
"So I'm going home." Hearing this, Zhao Hao Ning walked in front of Zhong Lizui with a look of joy on his face.
She put her hands behind her back, walked two steps backwards, looked at Zhong Lizou with a smile, and said pitifully: "Fiancé, you know, I can't go home now, and you are the only relative I have."
"Yeah." Zhongli Sui nodded.
Seeing that he responded to cooperate with her, Zhao Hao Ning was in a good mood and walked quickly ahead in the direction Zhong Lizui pointed.
Zhong Lizui, who was two steps behind her, stared at the talismans behind Zhao Hao Ning as they burned out one after another.
The flames burning in each one are blue.
Zhongli Sui's peach blossom eyes narrowed dangerously, and he snorted inwardly.
Little liar, not a word of truth in his mouth.
Zhao Hao Ning, who was walking in front, had no idea that dozens of mantra talismans were burning behind her.
She only felt that it was really difficult to climb the Wenjian Peak.
After climbing for a long time, we reached the halfway point of the mountain. All we could see were trees and endless stone stairs.
The climb up the mountain made Zhao Hao Ning's legs weak.
At this moment, she bent over and put her hands on her knees. She tilted her head and looked suspiciously at Zhong Lizui, who was strolling a few steps behind her and questioned: "Where is your residence? Apart from the two of us, I have been hiking for so long and I haven't seen a single person."
"Who said we were human beings after walking for so long?" Zhong Lizui asked.
He stepped forward in two steps and squatted in front of Zhao Hao Ning. He smiled strangely and said in a faint voice: "There are many spirits in the deep mountains and old forests. Maybe between you and me, only one of us is a real person."
"You said, the only real person, is it you... or me?" Zhong Lizui stretched out his hand, and his cold fingertips slid across the side of Zhao Hao Ning's neck.
Zhao Hao Ning's heart was beating violently while climbing the mountain. Now that he was so frightened, it started to beat even harder.
She raised her hand and slapped him hard on the right side of Zhong Lizou's face, shouting loudly: "You are so bold and evil, get off my fiancé quickly."
"Ah ah ah, evil spirits, retreat quickly! Back away, back away!" One slap was not enough, so Zhao Haining pressed Zhong Lizui's shoulders with both hands and shook him desperately.
Zhong Lizui, who had two slap marks on his left and right faces, one deep and one shallow, shook his head, quickly grabbed Zhao Hao Ning's wrist, and stood up: "Stop shaking, there is nothing evil."
"Fiancé, you don't know that an evil spirit just got into you and you were trying to scare me." Zhao Hao Ning sobbed pitifully.
What Zhongli Sui said was the explanation he intended to frighten Zhao Hao Ning when he saw Zhao Hao Ning was timid, but he didn't dare to say it for a long time.
I really don’t have the nerve to say it.
Zhao Hao Ning is timid, but she really dares to do it if something happens.
Zhong Lizui discovered twice in practice that even Zhao Ning dared to slap him.
